title: You can hire these humanoid robots to clean your home in San Francisco
snippet: In an interview with ABC7 San Francisco, UC Berkeley robotics professor Ken Goldberg expresses skepticism about the readiness of humanoid robots for home cleaning. He notes that picking up objects off the floor and wiping counters remain major challenges, and cautions against trusting sped-up demo videos.
match_reason: websearch (interview) — Ken Goldberg, UC Berkeley robotics professor, is interviewed and quoted regarding the limitations of humanoid home-cleaning robots.
